node.statement: Evaluating the right-hand side with the pinned masses and the actor transverse coordinates x_v = 0, x_w = -a*A, x_f = -A gives sum_Q c_Q * x_Q = (1 - tau)*0 + (tau + t)*(-a*A) + (-t)*(-A) = A*(t - a*(tau + t)).
